porkiesSection.title: All fifteen residents, one at a time.
porkiesSection.text: The names are honest: 脏脏猪 is the muddy one, 懒蛋猪 is the lazy one, and 贪吃猪 is, well, the one holding the corn.

footerText: Cochonnet Villa: all fifteen porkies present and accounted for.

story.title: Cochonnet Villa has exactly three rules, and all of them are easy to keep.
story.text: Nobody ever wrote them down, but all fifteen porkies know them by heart, especially the one about food.

cards.title: Blankets for everyone
cards.body: Soft blankets, warm lamps, and beds fluffed up in the sun. Anyone who gets sleepy may lie down right where they are. No excuse needed.

cards.title: Nobody eats alone
cards.body: Hot pot is the house favorite. When the pot starts to bubble, all fifteen squeeze in around it and everyone cooks their own favorite thing.

cards.title: Roll call goes to fifteen
cards.body: Thirteen about the same size, one extra big, one extra small. They get counted every night, and the lights stay on until the number comes out right.

villaSection.title: Hot springs, a mushroom tower, and more sunshine than fifteen pigs can use.
paragraphs: The main house has two floors and a glass front that looks out over the meadow. The hot springs steam away next door, and a round mushroom tower stands out on the grass. None of it is fancy, but every corner is soft enough to nap in.
The top floor of the tower is for stargazing: switch off the lamp and the whole Milky Way comes out. If you would like to look around yourself, the 3D villa map is always open.

rhythm.title: Morning
rhythm.body: One pig is up early wiping the windows. Another rolls over and pulls the star blanket a little tighter.

rhythm.title: Afternoon
rhythm.body: A soak in the hot springs, then a lie-down on the grass to dry: thirteen matching nap shapes in a row.

rhythm.title: Evening
rhythm.body: Hot pot, then roll call, then up the mushroom tower to watch the stars until somebody starts snoring.

hero.eyebrow: Warm, safe, and full of happy little snorts
hero.title: 15 little porkies live at Cochonnet Villa, and they are very good at it.
hero.text: Thirteen are about the same size, one is very big and very strong, and one is small enough to fit in a pocket. Their whole schedule is eating, soaking in the hot springs, and falling asleep in a pile.
hero.sceneNote: Thirteen about the same size, one very big, one very small. Count again: still fifteen.

seo.title: Cochonnet Villa | Home of 15 Happy Porkies
seo.description: Cochonnet Villa is the warm, safe home of 15 happy porkies: thirteen about the same size, one gentle giant and one tiny one, plus hot springs and a mushroom tower.

porkies.name: 脏脏猪
porkies.description: If there is a mud puddle, this pig is already in it. Stays clean for about five minutes after a bath and never stops grinning.

porkies.name: 机灵猪
porkies.description: Round glasses, wizard hat, and a spellbook nobody else can read. When a pig has a problem, this is the pig they ask.

porkies.name: 瓜呆猪
porkies.description: Wears a watermelon for a hat: cool in summer, stylish all year. Nothing bothers her, not even being pestered.

porkies.name: 呆瓜猪
porkies.description: Headset on, world off. Says “one more round, then bed,” and has said it six times tonight.

porkies.name: 乖乖猪
porkies.description: Red gingham scarf, soft voice, hooves together before every meal. By unanimous vote, the best-behaved pig in the villa.

porkies.name: 大呆猪
porkies.description: The biggest and strongest pig in the villa, usually with a white towel over one shoulder. He lifts weights, loves beef, and can carry a whole case of water without slowing down. He also takes up half the blanket. Underneath the muscles he is the gentlest of the lot, and the best one to nap against.

porkies.name: 懒蛋猪
porkies.description: Either asleep or on the way there, always wrapped in the star blanket. The only alarm clock that works is dinner.

porkies.name: 呆呆猪
porkies.description: The forehead says “dopey,” the gold chain says tough guy. In truth: easily spooked, always in a hurry, a hot pot grandmaster, and devoted to a cabbage named 白白菜.

porkies.name: 呱呱猪
porkies.description: Never puts the microphone down and talks even more than it sings. All villa news breaks here first.

porkies.name: 小色猪
porkies.description: A rose behind one ear and a wink for everyone. Self-appointed heartthrob of the villa. So far nobody has objected.

porkies.name: 贪吃猪
porkies.description: There is always a little sauce on one cheek. First to the table, last to leave, and stops by the kitchen afterwards just to “check.”

porkies.name: 小猪
porkies.description: The smallest pig in the villa, and the most capable. She makes the sukiyaki, hangs the fairy lights, and drives the little car, then disappears into the softest cushion in the house.

porkies.name: 臭臭猪
porkies.description: Takes a rubber duck to every bath and somehow comes out smellier. Calls it “having character.”

porkies.name: 香香猪
porkies.description: Bubble bath, perfume, a polka-dot bow, and half an hour to get ready. Watches the waistline, except at hot pot.

porkies.name: 勤劳猪
porkies.description: Headscarf on, apron tied, feather duster always moving. Believes dishes get washed tonight, and can scrub a whole piglet in thirty seconds.
